subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which open EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError fix path should own this broad issue before ClawSweeper queues or closes anything else?
rationale: The issue is valid but spans lock ownership, transcript fence semantics, delivery durability, and Telegram-visible typing behavior, with multiple overlapping open PRs already in flight.

options.title: Sequence existing fix PRs first
options.body: Review the message-loss and equal-line fence PRs as the main candidates, keep this issue open as the coordination point, and avoid a new competing fix PR.

options.title: Nominate a narrower canonical issue
options.body: Move the remaining work to one narrower open issue if maintainers decide this umbrella issue is too broad to own closure.

options.title: Request fresh live reproduction first
options.body: Pause implementation decisions until a maintainer or reporter provides current-main Telegram or cron reproduction artifacts.

recommendation.title: Sequence existing fix PRs first
recommendation.body: Review the message-loss and equal-line fence PRs as the main candidates, keep this issue open as the coordination point, and avoid a new competing fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The related history shows broad adjacent work across subagent delivery, session locks, and typing lifecycle, making this the best available routing owner for the sequencing decision.
